instruction:
You write tests/reviewer/runMutants.p22b.examples.test.ts only, a NEW file with the test of Run Mutants example 5 (examples 1-4 are already tested in tests/reviewer/runMutants.examples.test.ts, which you do not touch). Read docs/TASK_P22b_mutants.md sections 2.1 (the text H and the harness skeleton, verbatim: copy the helpers you use) and 2.2 (Run Mutants and its table) and 2.3. Import runMutants and runMutantsUntil (and the types you need) from "../../src/reviewer/runMutants.js", planMutants from "../../src/reviewer/planMutants.js", tmpRoot and fixtureJson from "../helpers.js", node:fs and node:path as you use them. One test "Run Mutants example 5: <what>" on a tmpRoot holding lib/h.ts = H, removed in finally, comparing each result whole with reviewer/untried.json's "stop", "zero" and "red" (literally `stopAt: 2500` for "stop"), the counting now's calls 0, lib/h.ts H again, and Object.keys of a runMutants result ["baseline", "results", "findings"]; test(..., 120000); then at most 6 of your own on section 2.2 rows. Strings with toBe, a whole document, result or state with toStrictEqual; a literal holding a single quote goes in a double-quoted string. No vi.mock, vi.stubGlobal, vi.useFakeTimers, no timer (setTimeout, setInterval, setImmediate), no function or variable named fetch or Fake*. Import only what you use; eslint rejects an unused import or constant and a `let` never reassigned.

The examples below are the criterion, and you are its independent author: write one test per example (no fewer, no merging), each named after the Function and the example number, e.g. "Run Mutants example 1".

Examples of Function Run Mutants:
1. given a tmpRoot holding src/f.ts = F = "export function f(a: number, b: number): boolean {\n return a === b && a > 0;\n}\n"; mutants = planMutants("src/f.ts", F, 10); command grep -q "a === b" src/f.ts, timeoutMs 5000, env {PATH}; when runMutants; then baseline {0, false}; results [src/f.ts 2 12 "=== → !==" killed exit 1], [2 18 "&& → ||" survived exit 0], [2 23 "> → >=" survived exit 0], timedOut false each; findings the two survivors, "mutation src/f.ts:2" expecting "a test fails on && → || at line 2" and "… > → >= …", got "every test passed"; src/f.ts is F again
2. given the same root and mutants; command echo run >> ran.txt; exit 3; when runMutants; then baseline {3, false}; results []; findings [{mutation, "mutation baseline", null, "the test command passes before any mutant: echo run >> ran.txt; exit 3", "exit 3"}]; ran.txt "run\n" (only the baseline ran); src/f.ts is F
3. given lib/g.ts = F, mutants planMutants("lib/g.ts", F, 10); command if grep -q "a !== b" lib/g.ts; then sleep 5; fi with timeoutMs 400; then command sleep 5 with timeoutMs 300; when runMutants; then results [=== → !== killed, exit null, timedOut true], [&& → || survived], [> → >= survived], two findings "mutation lib/g.ts:2"; lib/g.ts is F; then baseline {null, true}, results [], the finding got "timed out after 300 ms"
4. given command test "$MARK" = m1 && test -z "$OPENAI_API_KEY", env {PATH, MARK m1, OPENAI_API_KEY k}, mutants []; then MARK m2; then command true with one mutant {gen/new.ts, 1, 1, "true → false", "x\n"} on a root without gen/new.ts; when runMutants; then baseline {0, false}, results [], findings []; then baseline {1, false} and the finding got "exit 1"; then one survivor and gen/new.ts absent after the run
5. given a tmpRoot holding lib/h.ts = H = "export const h = (a: number, b: number): boolean => a === b && a > 0;\n", mutants = planMutants("lib/h.ts", H, 10), command grep -q "a === b" lib/h.ts, timeoutMs 5000, env {PATH}, now +1000 per call from 0 (first call 1000); stopAt 2500; then stopAt 0; then command exit 3 with stopAt 99 and a now that counts its calls; when runMutantsUntil; then untried.json "stop": baseline {0, false}, results [lib/h.ts 1 55 "=== → !==" killed exit 1, 1 61 "&& → ||" survived exit 0], one survivor finding, untried [{lib/h.ts, 1, 66, "> → >="}]; "zero": results [], findings [], untried the three spots; "red": baseline {3, false}, results [], the baseline finding got "exit 3", untried the three spots, now called 0 times; lib/h.ts is H again; runMutants on the same root gives the keys [baseline, results, findings] only; with a far stopAt (1000000) every mutant runs: results the three spots (55 killed, 61 and 66 survived), findings the TWO survivor findings (one per survivor), untried [] (ref: tests/fixtures/reviewer/untried.json (name → the result))

Data Mutant: One single-point mutant of a code file.
Schema:
{ path, line, column, rule, text }

Data Mutant Run: What Run Mutants resolves to.
Schema:
{ baseline: { exit: number | null, timedOut: boolean }, results: { path, line, column, rule, killed: boolean, exit: number | null, timedOut: boolean }[], findings: Finding[] } — runMutantsUntil adds untried: { path, line, column, rule }[]
